verified_properties: Request validation enforces strict identifier allowlists, path-component checks on workspace and request filenames, positive epoch/attempt bounds, mode restriction (review or code), runtime bounds (30..900s), and prompt byte bounds (1..65536).
Canonical job lookup binds job ID prefix to plan, enforces single-row decoding, and matches job args JSON against parent plan, task, worker, attempt, workspace, and mode.

Dual clock-domain fencing verifies continuity and requires both UTC task lease and boot-domain coordinator/workspace leases to cover runtime_seconds plus a 30s safety margin before launch and at collection.

Sandbox configuration mounts root read-only, hides global /home/an/.gemini via tmpfs while mounting only the private profile and config, isolates /run/user/1000 to expose only the filtered org.freedesktop.secrets D-Bus proxy socket read-only, and binds the workspace writable only in code mode.
Exclusive active-job.json and per-unit output/receipt creation prevent automatic retry after ambiguous launch while preserving evidence for operator reconciliation.

Result classification fails closed on systemd non-success results, non-zero exit codes, stderr print-timeout diagnostics, stdout exceeding 1 MiB, malformed JSON, non-SUCCESS status, or empty/whitespace response and conversation_id, while never granting automatic task completion or runtime admission.

limits: Review is static over the supplied source files and provided EUnit output (chunk eae2b9); no tools were invoked and no additional runtime tests were executed.
External harness modules (cepaf_gleam/harness/admission, development, files, clock, and uos_swarm session modules) were evaluated only at their call boundaries.

Same-user hostile host interference outside the bwrap/systemd user unit boundary and lease expiration when collection occurs after remaining lease drops below runtime_seconds + 30s are outside the stated isolation and launch-lease guarantees.
Caller maintains coordinator heartbeat; collection needs fresh authority
Task completion remains explicit and requires independent result review
Private pre-provisioned profile and installed host tools are finite dependencies
